title: Ibne muljim ne hyder ko maara
body:
ibne muljim ne hyder ko maara
rozedaro qayamat ke din hai
tumse chut-ta hai maula tumhara
<<MINI>>
rozedaro qayamat....
<<DIVIDER>>
sooni qabre rasoole khuda hai
ghar may zehra ke maatam buka hai
khaak udaata hai hyder ka kunba
<<MINI>>
rozedaro qayamat....
<<DIVIDER>>
aale ahmed pe aafat hai aayi
bekason par yateemi hai chaayi
uthgaya sar se hyder ka saaya
<<MINI>>
rozedaro qayamat....
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar may khaaliq ke hyder ko maara
janasheen e payambar ko maara
haye sajde may sarwar ko maara
rozedaro qayamat.... kyun na roye ye wo gham nahi hai
shab ye ashoor se kam nahi hai
khuld me bhi ye matam hai barpa
<<MINI>>
rozedaro qayamat....
<<DIVIDER>>
dil hilaate hai zainab ke naale
khaak udaate hai sab kunbe waale
uth raha hai ali ka janaza
<<MINI>>
rozedaro qayamat....
